info.title: Ayni API
info.description: RESTful API of Ayni, an academic time bank where university students exchange tutoring hours as credits. Every route except asking for an access link and opening it needs the session token that opening the link returns, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. The university and the person of a request are the ones of its session.

get.summary: The whiteboard of a session, for its student or its tutor
get.description: Every element drawn and the version they correspond to, in any state of the session: while it is in progress, and as it was left once it closed. A session where nothing was drawn answers an empty board with hasActivity false. Drawing happens on the live channel, a WebSocket at /api/v1/sessions/{id}/whiteboard/live that first sends this same board and then every operation, in version order.

403.description: The reader is neither the student nor the tutor of the session

404.description: The session does not exist in this university

put.summary: Replaces the whole whiteboard of a session in progress
put.description: Sends every element the board will hold together with the version last read. When somebody drew since that version the answer is 409 and nothing changes: read it again. Both participants connected to the live channel receive the new board.

200.description: Replaced; the body is the new board

400.description: An element without id or type, more than 2000 elements or one over 16 KB

403.description: The caller is neither the student nor the tutor of the session

404.description: The session does not exist in this university

409.description: The session is not in progress, or the board changed since that version

put.description: Updates only fields controlled by the student. Academic data is read-only.

get.summary: What the student needs help with
get.description: US41: the catalogue items the student said they need help with, sorted by name. The whole set, since it is what the student edits and sends back with PUT.

put.summary: Replaces what the student needs help with
put.description: US41: the items sent become the whole set, at any moment after the onboarding: those left out are dropped and an empty list leaves none. What the student teaches is not touched (it is managed under /api/v1/tutor/skills), and neither is any booking already confirmed. Answers the set as GET does.

400.description: catalogItemIds is missing or null, has more than 50 items, or an item is not an identifier

404.description: An item does not exist or belongs to another university; nothing changed

put.description:
US50: an active coordinator updates the logo and colours of
their own university. The university is obtained from the
authenticated tenant context and cannot be selected in the request.

get.summary: The recognition rule in force at the university
get.description: US27, US28: the hours the university asks of a student before it considers recognition, and the day it started to apply. Until a coordinator sets one, recognition is not open: students see no requirement and cannot submit a request.

200.description: The rule in force today in the university's calendar

403.description: The person asking is not an active coordinator

404.description: The university has not set a rule

put.summary: Sets the recognition rule of the university
put.description:
US27, US28: the coordinator says how many hours of verified sessions a student must have taught, from a day of the university's calendar (today when omitted, never in the past). The rule in force is closed and the new one added in one step: rules are never edited, so what students already submitted keeps the figures it was presented with.

A rule that starts later leaves the current one running until that day. When two coordinators set a rule at the same moment, both succeed one after the other and the last one is the rule in force.

400.description: The hours are not a whole number of at least 1, or the day is not a date or is past

403.description: The person asking is not an active coordinator

get.summary: The baseline credit policy of the university
get.description: US52: the policy an active coordinator would supersede, the one students are granted when they are activated. Answers 404 when the university has none and 403 to anybody who is not an active coordinator of it.

put.summary: Supersede the university baseline credit policy
put.description:
US52: an active coordinator replaces the current baseline credit policy
of their own university. The previous version remains stored as history.
Future initial grants use the new policy.

put.summary: Update or deactivate a campus benefit (university coordinator only)

get.summary: The minimum grade needed to teach a course
get.description: US51: the grade a student needs in a course to teach it. While the coordinator has not set one it is the grade the university was registered with, and updatedAt is absent.

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

put.summary: Sets the minimum grade needed to teach a course
put.description:
US51: when a student offers a course, it is enabled on its own only if their grade reaches this value. Changing it applies to the offers made from then on: the ones already granted are kept as they were.

The grade is on the scale of 0 to 20, with at most two decimals.

400.description: The grade is missing, outside the scale, or the body cannot be read

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

put.summary: Replace the email domains of a university
put.description: US50: the complete list of institutional domains the university is recognised by, at least one, kept in lower case and without repeats. A domain that belongs to another university, active or not, is refused. Only a platform administrator edits them; the coordinator of the university does not.

200.description: The university with its new list of domains

400.description: The list is empty, or a domain is blank or has an at sign or spaces

404.description: The university does not exist

409.description: A domain already belongs to another university

get.summary: Read the simulated payment provider
get.description: The outcomes it answers now and the state of the circuit in front of it: closed, open or half open, the failures in a row and until when it stays open. Demo profile only.

put.summary: Switch what the simulated payment provider answers
put.description: Changes the outcome of the first charge, of the later check of a pending purchase, or both, from the next call on. The outcomes are CONFIRMED, REJECTED, PENDING and UNAVAILABLE. Demo profile only.

200.description: The outcomes and the circuit after the switch

400.description: No outcome is given, or one is not CONFIRMED, REJECTED, PENDING or UNAVAILABLE

get.summary: Read the demo clock
get.description: The instant every rule of the application reads, the real time and the offset between them. Demo profile only.

put.summary: Set the demo clock at an instant
put.description: Takes the clock to that UTC instant; it keeps running from there. Demo profile only.

Ten minutes before a session at 15:00 in.description: Ten minutes before a session at 15:00 in Lima

200.description: The clock at the instant asked for

400.description: at is missing, is not an ISO 8601 instant, or is too far from the real time

delete.summary: Take the demo clock back to the real time
delete.description: The offset goes back to zero. Demo profile only.

200.description: The clock at the real time

post.summary: Donate earned credits to the incoming-student pool
post.description: Send confirmed=false to receive the irreversible-operation warning without spending credits. Submit its confirmationId with the same Idempotency-Key and confirmed=true.

post.summary: Redeem earned credits for a campus benefit
post.description: Send confirmed=false to receive the irreversible-operation warning without spending credits. Submit its confirmationId with the same Idempotency-Key and confirmed=true.

get.summary: The skills the tutor offers, each with where it stands
get.description: US18, scenario 1: every skill the tutor offers or ever offered, with its status, the path it was accredited through and the date its status last changed. Withdrawn skills are listed too, so the tutor can offer one again.

200.description: The tutor's skills, sorted by name

post.summary: Offers a university course the tutor already passed
post.description:
US13: enabled the moment the grade the academic system reports clears the university's threshold, with no further steps.

Only university courses are enabled here. A global tool has no academic record to check against, and is refused with a message pointing at reviewed evidence instead, with one exception: a tool the tutor withdrew after a coordinator accepted their evidence is enabled again without a new review.

400.description: The item is global, the course is not approved, or the grade is too low

404.description: The catalogue item does not exist, or is not visible to this university

409.description: The tutor already offers this item

post.summary: Presents evidence for a global tool
post.description:
US16: a tutor who learned a tool by working attaches a portfolio or a certificate, and it waits for a coordinator of their university. The identifier in the path is the one of the catalogue item, because the skill does not exist until the first submission.

Between one and three files, each a PDF, a PNG or a JPEG of at most 5 MB. The first submission creates the skill as pending. After a rejection the same call puts it back in the queue with the new files, and the earlier submission stays as history. Courses are refused: they are enabled by the academic record.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the catalogue item, a global tool

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Anything the reviewer should know, at most 1000 characters

files.description: The portfolio or certificate: one to three PDF, PNG or JPEG files

201.description: The evidence was received and waits for a review

400.description: No files, too many, too big, not a PDF or an image, or the item is a course

404.description: The catalogue item does not exist, or is not visible to this university

409.description: The evidence already waits for a review, or the tool is already enabled

get.summary: The tools the student proposed and where each stands
get.description: US42, scenario 3: every proposal of the student, newest first, with its status and, once a moderator resolved it, the decision and the reason. An approved one carries the catalogue item it created, which the student can then offer.

post.summary: Proposes a tool the catalogue does not have
post.description:
US42: a student who masters a tool that is not in the catalogue proposes it with a name, a category and a short description. It waits for a moderator to resolve it.

Before it is recorded, the catalogue is compared with the name. If skills that look like it exist, the answer is 409 with the list, and the student sends the same request again with confirmDistinct set to true when theirs is a different one. A name the catalogue already has, or a proposal the student already has waiting, is refused whatever they confirm.

201.description: The proposal, waiting for a moderator

400.description: The name has fewer than three characters or too many, or the description is too long

404.description: The category does not exist

409.description: Skills that look like it exist and it was not confirmed (with the list), the catalogue has that name, or the student already has it waiting

get.summary: Read back the availability the tutor declared
get.description:
The rules the signed in tutor's hours are generated from, not the hours themselves
(those are the agenda): their weekly ranges, their date exceptions and their pauses, in
the university's time zone. Only what still governs from today on, today being the
university's day: a range removed, or with a last day already gone, is not listed; an
exception of a past date is not; a pause ended early or already over is not, while the
one under way and the ones to come are. Ranges are sorted by day of the week and hour,
exceptions by date and hour (a whole day first), pauses by their first day. Any list
may be empty. It is never paged: it holds only what one tutor declared.

200.description: What the tutor declared, possibly nothing

A range, a removed hour and a pause.description: A range, a removed hour and a pause

post.summary: Declare weekly tutor availability
post.description: Creates a recurring availability range for the tutor making the request and generates its one-hour blocks for the coming weeks, in the university's time zone. Overlapping ranges are rejected, while adjacent ranges are allowed. A tutor without an enabled skill keeps the range but gets no blocks, and the answer carries a notice saying why.

400.description: The request is invalid or the range overlaps an existing pattern

post.summary: Pause tutor availability
post.description: Pauses all availability for the tutor during the inclusive date range. Overlapping pauses are rejected. The hours of those days that already exist, free or held, are withdrawn at once and leave the search. Booked hours stand: the answer counts them and says so.

201.description: The pause was created and its hours withdrawn

400.description: The request is invalid or the pause overlaps an existing pause

post.summary: Add a date-specific availability exception
post.description: Adds extraordinary availability or removes availability for one date. A REMOVE without times covers the whole day. The hours of that date follow at once: a REMOVE withdraws the free or held hours it covers, which leave the search, and an ADD generates the hours it gives. Booked hours stand: the answer counts them and says so.

201.description: The exception was created and the hours of that date adjusted

400.description: The request is invalid

get.summary: What the caller registered about a completed session
get.description:
Answers only what the caller left, in their own direction: a student reads the stars, tags and comment they gave, a tutor reads the three facts and the comment they reported. Neither reads what the other left, and nothing says who rated whom.

When the caller has not rated the session yet, the answer is 200 with rated set to false, so the client can offer to rate it.

200.description: The caller's own rating of the session, or rated false

400.description: The session id is not a UUID

403.description: The caller is not a participant of the session

404.description: There is no completed session with that id in this university

post.summary: Rates a completed tutoring session
post.description:
A student rates the tutor with stars and optional tags.
A tutor reports punctuality, connection quality and whether
the session flowed normally.

Each participant may rate the session once in their direction.

400.description: The stars of a student, or one of the three facts of a tutor, are missing

403.description: The caller is not a participant of the session

404.description: The session does not exist, or is not available for rating in this university

409.description: That participant already rated the session

post.summary: Confirm presence with the emailed code
post.description: Five minutes after the scheduled start each participant receives a six digit code by email. Typing it in here, while the session is in progress and within fifteen minutes of receiving it, confirms their presence. Only a participant who joined the session can confirm. A wrong code spends one of five attempts; after the fifth the code is useless. Typing a confirmed code again changes nothing.

400.description: The code is not six digits, a header is missing or the id is not a UUID

403.description: The person is neither the student nor the tutor of the session

404.description: The session does not exist in this university

409.description: Presence cannot be confirmed now: the code was not sent yet, it expired, its attempts are spent, the participant never joined, or the session is not in progress

422.description: Not the code that was sent. The attempt counts, and the message says how many are left

value.message: That is not the code you were sent. Attempts left: 4

post.summary: Send my presence code again
post.description: For a participant whose email with the presence code did not arrive. Replaces the code with a new one that lives the full fifteen minutes, and sends it by email: the old code stops working at once and the answer never carries the code. Only a participant who joined can ask, for their own code, while the session is in progress, after the code was issued and before it is confirmed. A code can be sent again three times per person and session, at least sixty seconds apart (ayni.sessions.presence-resend-max and presence-resend-min-interval). The wrong attempts already spent are kept: a person who spent all five cannot get another code.

202.description: The new code is on its way by email. Nothing is answered

400.description: The id is not a UUID

403.description: The person is neither the student nor the tutor of the session

404.description: The session does not exist in this university

409.description: The code cannot be sent again now: the session is not in progress, the person never joined, the code was not issued yet, presence is already confirmed, the five attempts are spent, the three resends are used up, or the last one was less than sixty seconds ago

value.message: The presence code was resent a moment ago. Try again at 2026-09-30T20:07:45Z

post.summary: Join the session's room
post.description: Lets the student or the tutor into the video call, from fifteen minutes before the start until the scheduled end, and answers with the room name and when each participant first arrived. Entering does not start the session: it starts, and SessionStarted is published once, when both participants have entered before ten minutes have passed since the scheduled start. If one is still missing then, the session is abandoned. Joining again, after a dropped connection, changes nothing.

400.description: A header is missing or the id is not a UUID

403.description: The person is neither the student nor the tutor of the session

404.description: The session does not exist in this university

409.description: The room is not open: too early, already over, or the session will not happen

value.message: The room opens fifteen minutes before the session starts, at 2026-09-30T19:45:00Z

post.summary: Confirm the session is over
post.description: Records that this participant confirms the end. When both have, the session closes: COMPLETED if both confirmed their presence with the emailed code, and the tutor is credited the booked hours as earned credits; UNVERIFIED otherwise, and the student is refunded. If only one confirms, the session closes on its own fifteen minutes after the booked hour, the same way. Only a participant who joined can confirm. Confirming again changes nothing.

200.description: The end is confirmed; the status says whether the session closed

400.description: A header is missing or the id is not a UUID

403.description: The person is neither the student nor the tutor of the session

404.description: The session does not exist in this university

409.description: The session is not in progress, or the person never joined it

value.message: This session is completed: only a session in progress can be ended

post.summary: Asks the university to recognise the hours taught
post.description:
US28: a student who reached the hours their university asks for submits a request. It is registered with the total of hours, the sessions that back it and the ratings the tutor received, copied now so that the coordinator reads what was presented.

The sessions are the oldest ones no request has used, until the hours asked for are reached; the student keeps the rest for the next request. A session backs one request and never a second one. The credits are not consumed: they stay available to book sessions.

With fewer hours than the university asks for, nothing is registered and the answer says how many are missing (409, missingHours).

404.description: The person is not a user of this university

409.description: The student has not taught the hours asked for (and the answer says how many are missing), or the university has not opened recognition

get.summary: List the current student's credit purchases
get.description: Shows pending purchases as well as their final outcome. For a pending purchase, follow the guidance and check this list again instead of starting another payment.

post.summary: Buy credits for tutoring
post.description:
Starts a simulated payment for the requested credits. The monthly allowance is five
confirmed credits per student, measured by UTC calendar month. The simulator charges
S/ 5.00 per credit by default. Use a new Idempotency-Key for a new payment attempt.
Confirmed credits are credited by the existing PurchaseConfirmed wallet listener and
never expire.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for this student's purchase attempt

200.description: The purchase is already pending or the same idempotent request was repeated

201.description: The purchase attempt was created; status is CONFIRMED or FAILED

202.description: The provider has no final result yet. Check GET /api/v1/payments/purchases; do not retry

409.description: The monthly allowance was reached or the requested credits exceed what remains

example.message: Monthly purchase limit is 5 credits; 4 already used; maximum available now is 1

post.summary: Mark one of my notices as read
post.description: Records that the person has seen the notice. Marking one that is already read changes nothing and keeps the first date. A notice of somebody else, of another university or that does not exist is not found.

400.description: The identifier is not a UUID

404.description: The person has no such notice in this university

post.summary: Mark all my notices as read
post.description: Records that the person has seen every notice they had not read. The ones already read keep their date, and having none unread is not an error.

post.summary: Finishes the onboarding with what the student needs and can teach
post.description:
US40: the last step, after the profile and the academic record. Both lists are asked of every student, whatever their term: either may be empty, but neither may be left out. The needs are saved; each item the student can teach is offered through the academic record, as POST /api/v1/tutor/skills does, and one their record does not back, or a global tool, is skipped rather than refused. Then the onboarding step becomes COMPLETED, which GET /api/v1/me shows.

All in one transaction: a refusal saves nothing and leaves the step as it was. Sent again once COMPLETED, it changes nothing that is already there and answers the same. The courses the record suggests are in GET /api/v1/tutor/skills/suggestions.

200.description: The onboarding is complete: the saved needs and the skills enabled

400.description: learning or teaching is missing or null, has more than 50 items, or an item is not an identifier

404.description: An item does not exist or belongs to another university

409.description: The profile or the academic record is not done yet

post.summary: Import my academic record
post.description: Refreshes the authenticated student's academic record from the university academic system.

post.summary: Approves or rejects a submission
post.description: US16: approving enables the tool for the tutor by the reviewed evidence, and the request keeps who decided and when. Rejecting needs a reason, because the student reads it and submits again from there. A submission is decided once.

400.description: A rejection without a reason, or a body that cannot be read

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

404.description: No submission has that identifier in this university

409.description: The submission was already decided

post.summary: Approves, joins or rejects a proposal
post.description:
US43: APPROVE adds the tool to the catalogue as a global item, available to every university. MERGE joins the proposal to a skill the catalogue already has, given in catalogItemId, and creates nothing: the student reads that item in their proposals. REJECT needs a reason, because the student reads it. The proposal keeps who decided, when and how. A proposal is resolved once.

Approving a name the catalogue already has is refused with a conflict: join it instead.

400.description: A rejection without a reason, a merge without an item, an item with another decision, a retired item, or a body that cannot be read

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

404.description: The proposal, or the item to join it to, is not visible in this university

409.description: The proposal was already resolved, or the catalogue already has that name

post.summary: Approves or rejects a recognition request
post.description:
US29: the coordinator decides after reviewing the case, and always says why. The decision is recorded with who took it, when and the reason, and the student reads it in their requests. RecognitionResolved is published so the student is told.

A request is decided once: deciding it again is a conflict, and when two coordinators decide at the same moment only one of them succeeds. Ayni certifies nothing by itself: this keeps what the university decided.

400.description: The decision is neither APPROVE nor REJECT, or the reason is missing or too long

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

404.description: The request does not exist in this university

409.description: The request was already decided

post.summary: Retires a catalogue item
post.description:
US44: the item can no longer be offered and the search stops finding it. Every tutor who offered it has the offer withdrawn, and the sessions already booked stand.

The moderator first reads how many tutors are affected in the usage of the item, and confirms by sending that number as confirmedTutors. If it is no longer the number of tutors who offer the item, nothing is retired and the conflict says the number as it is now. Offers still waiting for a review are not counted: they can no longer be approved, and the coordinator rejects them.

Only an item of the coordinator's own university can be retired: a global tool is shared by every university and is refused with 403, which leaves it to the platform administrator.

400.description: The confirmation is missing or negative, or the body cannot be read

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator, or the item is a global tool

404.description: The item does not exist, or is a course of another university

409.description: The item is already retired, or the number of tutors changed since it was read

post.summary: Joins a duplicate item to the one that stays
post.description:
US44: two items of the university that are the same skill become one. The item in the path is the duplicate and is retired; intoCatalogItemId is the one that stays.

Everything the duplicate had moves to the one that stays: the offers and accreditations of its tutors keep their status, and an enabled tutor keeps being found in the search. A tutor who already held both keeps the one on the item that stays and has the other withdrawn. The learning interests, the proposals that ended in the duplicate and the sessions counted on it follow. The sessions already booked stand.

Both must be courses of the coordinator's university: if either is a global tool, shared by every university, nothing changes and the answer is 403.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the duplicate, which is retired

400.description: The same item twice, the item that would stay is retired, or the body cannot be read

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator, or either item is a global tool

404.description: An item does not exist, or is a course of another university

409.description: The duplicate is already retired

get.summary: Every campus benefit of the university, deactivated ones included (coordinator only)

post.summary: Create a campus benefit (university coordinator only)
Dismiss an alert with a reason
post.description: US47: the coordinator decides the pattern is not a problem. The alert is closed as DISMISSED with who decided and when, the reason stays with it, and the decision is also written in the activity log. An alert is decided once: dismissing one that was already resolved is refused, also when two coordinators do it at the same moment.

400.description: A header is missing, the id is not a UUID, or the reason is missing or too long

403.description: The person is not an active coordinator of the university

404.description: The alert does not exist in this university

409.description: The alert was already resolved

post.summary: Synchronises the courses with the academic system
post.description: The courses of the university become the ones its academic system says (ADR 0006), loaded as POST /courses loads a typed list: the course code is the key, new courses are added, names are updated, retired ones are brought back and nothing is removed. A course keeps the description a coordinator gave it. The minimum teaching grade is not touched. All or nothing; sending it twice in a row leaves the catalogue as the first one did.

200.description: The courses are synchronised, each with what happened to it

403.description: The person asking is not an active coordinator

404.description: The university has no academic system configured

get.summary: The courses of the university
get.description: US51: the courses the university has loaded, by course code, with the retired ones marked as such.

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

post.summary: Loads the courses of the curriculum
post.description:
US51: the courses become available for the students of the university to search for and to offer. Loading adds and updates: a course already there takes the name and description of the list, a retired one is brought back, and one missing from the list is left as it was. To take a course out, retire it.

All or nothing: a list with a blank code or name, or a code twice, saves nothing. The code is what the academic system reports on an approved course.

200.description: The courses are loaded, each with what happened to it

400.description: The list is empty or too long, a code or a name is missing or too long, a code is repeated, or the body cannot be read

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

post.summary: Takes a course out of the curriculum
post.description:
US51: the course can no longer be offered and the search stops finding it. The tutors who offered it have the offer withdrawn, and the sessions already booked stand.

The coordinator first reads how many tutors are affected in the usage of the course (GET /api/v1/coordinator/catalog/{id}/usage) and confirms by sending that number as confirmedTutors. If it is no longer the number of tutors who offer the course, nothing is retired and the conflict says the number as it is now.

Only the courses of the university: a global tool is not found here.

400.description: The confirmation is missing or negative, or the body cannot be read

403.description: The person asking is not a coordinator

404.description: It is not a course of this university

409.description: The course is already retired, or the number of tutors changed since it was read

post.summary: Book the hours the student is holding
post.description: Confirms a booking of consecutive hours the student holds, in one transaction: the tutor is enabled for the subject, the hours are consecutive and held by the student, one credit per hour is charged (credits closest to expiring first), the hours are marked as booked, the booking is saved and BookingConfirmed is published. If anything fails nothing is charged and the student's holds on those hours are released.

201.description: The booking is confirmed and the credits were charged
